tool_input.command:
python3 -c "
from mem_mcp.mcp.tool_descriptions import TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS

REQUIRED_WORKFLOW_TOOLS = [
    'mindmap_workflow_create',
    'mindmap_workflow_get',
    'mindmap_workflow_activate',
    'mindmap_workflow_propose_move',
    'mindmap_workflow_signoff',
    'mindmap_workflow_cancel_move',
    'mindmap_workflow_remap',
    'mindmap_workflow_pending_signoffs',
    'mindmap_work_list',
    'mindmap_work_get',
    'mindmap_work_history',
]

print('Presence check:')
for tool in REQUIRED_WORKFLOW_TOOLS:
    present = tool in TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS
    print(f'  {tool}: {present}')

print()
print('Word count and structure check:')
import re
for tool in REQUIRED_WORKFLOW_TOOLS:
    if tool in TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS:
        desc = TOOL_DESCRIPTIONS[tool]
        word_count = len(desc.split())
        has_call = bool(re.search(r'\bcall\s+when:', desc, re.IGNORECASE))
        has_no_call = bool(re.search(r'\bdo\s+not\s+call\s+for:', desc, re.IGNORECASE))
        has_examples = bool(re.search(r'\bexamples:', desc, re.IGNORECASE))
        status = 'OK' if (80 <= word_count <= 250 and has_call and has_no_call and has_examples) else 'FAIL'
        print(f'  {tool}: {word_count} words, call={has_call}, no_call={has_no_call}, examples={has_examples} [{status}]')
"
